summary: W4: apply standard OpenAPI + OCL elevations so authorized release restores held quantity to available stock (and completes the release success channel left as a W3 placeholder); keep W3 UnauthorizedError no-mutation posts/channels; plan derived Vitest from the elevated OCL; defer formal; do not regress W1–W3.

human_gate.reason: Additive elevation of existing release surface for R4/SC4; authz_boundary at standard density; no money_boundary, breaking_change, or formal apply. W3 left explicit OpenAPI/OCL hooks for authorized restore; stack and Scenario are clear.

targets.rationale: http_boundary + authz_boundary: W4 requires clients/tests to observe authorized release as a checkable success that restores held quantity to available stock. Elevate POST /reservations/{holdId}/release 204 from the W3 placeholder to first-class restore semantics without removing or thinning the 403 UnauthorizedError no-mutation channel. additive_change on shared OpenAPI; not breaking_change. TTL expiry remains W5.

human_gate.reason: Additive documentation of authorized restore on an existing release operation; no breaking API change.

targets.rationale: domain_contract + authz_boundary: R4/SC4 demand that when an authorized opaque principal releases an existing soft-hold, held quantity returns to available stock. Elevate Reservation::release W4 hooks (pre HoldExists; post AvailableStockRestored, and hold removal consistent with restore) while retaining PrincipalAuthorized and W3 unauthorized no-mutation posts. Derived Vitest under tests/contracts/** must cover the authorized restore property without regressing W1–W3. additive_change on shared OCL.

human_gate.reason: Standard DbC elevation for authorized release restore; no money or formal apply.

targets.rationale: concurrency_safety / distributed consistency remain out of demand (Change Context §5; Brief X8). No Phase 3 formal apply conditions; defer rather than silently omit.

human_gate.reason: Formal deferred; no Phase 3 apply conditions met.
